Straight answers

Panicked? Read this first.

What do I do first if water is leaking or flooding?

If it is safe, shut off the water source and power to affected areas, move valuables out of the water, and call (305) 794-1378. Tell us what is wet and whether water is still spreading — scope and timing are confirmed by phone.

What do I do first after a fire?

Do not re-enter until fire officials say it is safe, and do not try to clean soot yourself. Then call (305) 794-1378 for cleanup and restoration next steps.

How fast can someone come out?

A1A Restorations offers 24/7 emergency service. When you call, describe what happened and how urgent it is — the team confirms scope and timing by phone. No arrival time is promised on this page.

Do you handle mold or biohazard cleanup?

Yes — mold testing and removal, biohazard cleanup, and trauma cleanup are listed services. For biohazard, keep people and pets away from the area, avoid contact with it, and call first if you are unsure it is safe.

What should I have ready when I call?

What happened, where the damage is, whether it is still spreading, whether the area is safe to enter, and the property address. The triage above turns those answers into a summary you can call or text in.

Which building inspection do I need?

NSPIRE, REAC, and 40- and 50-year building inspections are offered. Call (305) 794-1378 with the property type and any notice or requirement you received, and confirm scope and booking details by phone.
